projects.title: Apple Stock Price Prediction System
projects.description: Machine learning application that forecasts Apple stock prices from historical market data using an LSTM-based deep learning model, served through an interactive Streamlit app.
projects.problem: Forecast future Apple stock prices from historical market trends to support data-driven investment analysis.
projects.solution: End-to-end ML pipeline covering data collection, cleaning, feature engineering and normalization, followed by LSTM model training, prediction, evaluation and an interactive Streamlit interface for exploring forecasts.
projects.outcome: A completed deep-learning project demonstrating the full time-series forecasting workflow — from raw market data to a deployed Streamlit app — aligned to Data Scientist and Python Developer roles.
projects.resumeSummary: Built an LSTM-based Apple stock price prediction system in Python (TensorFlow/Keras) with a Streamlit interface for interactive forecasting.
projects.interviewExplanation: I framed this as a time-series forecasting problem: collect historical Apple prices, clean and normalize the series, engineer lag features, then train an LSTM in TensorFlow/Keras. I evaluate the model on held-out data and expose predictions through a Streamlit app so the workflow is interactive end-to-end. It's the project I use to explain deep learning for sequences and the full data-science lifecycle.

projects.title: Product Recommendation System
projects.description: Recommendation engine that suggests relevant products from historical purchase and rating data using classical ML techniques.
projects.problem: Users on product catalogs struggle to discover items relevant to their preferences when catalogs are large and unfiltered.
projects.solution: A Python pipeline that cleans and prepares product/user data with Pandas and NumPy, then generates recommendations using Scikit-learn similarity models.
projects.outcome: A working recommendation prototype demonstrating the full data-science workflow from raw data to model output.
projects.resumeSummary: Built a product recommendation prototype in Python using Pandas, NumPy and Scikit-learn similarity models.
projects.interviewExplanation: I framed this as a similarity problem: clean the interaction data with Pandas, vectorise the products, and compute similarity with Scikit-learn to return top-N recommendations. It's my go-to example for explaining how EDA, feature engineering and model choice fit together in a data-science project.

projects.title: Job Tracker API
projects.description: REST API for tracking job applications end-to-end — create, update, list and delete applications with a clean Flask backend.
projects.problem: Job seekers lose track of applications across companies, roles and statuses without a structured system to store and query them.
projects.solution: A Flask-based REST API exposing CRUD endpoints for job applications, backed by a MySQL schema for durable storage and querying.
projects.outcome: A working Python backend project demonstrating REST API design, database integration and end-to-end request handling.
projects.resumeSummary: Built a Flask REST API with MySQL for tracking job applications, showcasing CRUD design and backend fundamentals.
projects.interviewExplanation: I designed a Flask app around a job-application resource: routes for create/read/update/delete, a MySQL table for persistence, and JSON request/response handling. It's the project I use to explain REST fundamentals — request lifecycle, status codes, and separating routing from data access.

projects.title: Sales Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive Power BI dashboard summarising sales performance across products, regions and time periods for business decision-making.
projects.problem: Business stakeholders need a single, trustworthy view of sales KPIs instead of scattered Excel files and manual reports.
projects.solution: A Power BI report modelled from SQL/Excel sources, with cleaned data, calculated KPIs and interactive visuals for slicing by product, region and period.
features: KPI cards for revenue, orders and growth
Interactive slicers by region, product and period
SQL-sourced data model with cleaned inputs
projects.outcome: A dashboard that turns raw sales data into a decision-ready view — the core deliverable expected of Data Analyst and MIS Analyst roles.
projects.resumeSummary: Built a Power BI sales dashboard on SQL/Excel sources with KPI cards and interactive slicers for business reporting.
projects.interviewExplanation: I treated this like a real reporting request: understand the KPIs stakeholders care about, model the data in Power BI from SQL/Excel sources, and design visuals that answer questions in one click. It's the project I use to talk through the Data Analyst / MIS Analyst workflow end-to-end.
